goal:
Something's wrong with our note tagging — tags keep bleeding between notes. I tagged one
note "errand" this morning and now a completely unrelated note shows the same tag, even
though I never tagged it. Tags are supposed to stick to the note they were added to;
notes are independent. Can you fix the tagger?

hows.text: Implement a strict, isolated tagging state machine in tagger/notes.py that enforces a single active tag per note, preventing cross-note tag bleed by strictly validating and applying tags independently.
hows.reason: This directly addresses the core issue of tags bleeding between unrelated notes by enforcing strict isolation and validation at the source of tagging logic.

hows.text: Audit and isolate the tagging logic within tagger/notes.py by removing any shared mutable tag state or global variables that could inadvertently carry over tags between different note objects.
hows.reason: This approach targets the root cause of the bleeding by eliminating shared mutable state, ensuring each note maintains its own independent tagging context.
